title: Workbench
direction: A large worker terminal beside supporting sessions, with a persistent phase inspector.
tokens: Neutral graphite and porcelain, muted blue selection, system sans-serif chrome, monospace terminal text, 4px spacing scale.
proposed: Working and no-output state previews extend the current synthetic fixture; real states require structured runtime events.
Asymmetric panes or equal-column layout are proposed presentation changes.
Terminal text scaling up to 200% is proposed from Apple HIG guidance; browser accessibility still needs validation.
The source's layout presets are omitted from application chrome; production placement is undecided.
notes: Host selection shows every session on that host. No duplicate top navigation. No live Ghostty, PTY or CLI connection. Worker/reviewer terminals are illustrative, not a claim about Agent subagent capabilities.
